descript.abstract: The U.S. Geological Survey's Minerals Yearbook Volume III: Area Reports — International publication provides an annual review of the mineral and materials industries of over 150 countries worldwide. This volume of work includes individual country reports that examine the performance and developments of a country's mineral industry that occurred during a given year. Topics covered in each country report may include mineral production and trade, government policies and programs, industry structure, and developments in the commodity sector. Tabular data include mineral commodity production statistics over a 5-year period and a summary of mineral facilities including annual production capacities, where data are available. The 2024 Minerals Yearbook Volume III: Area Reports — International data release provides a compilation of the Minerals Yearbook country reports discussing information, events, data, and statistics for the year 2024, mineral commodity production data for the years 2020 through 2024, and country-level mineral facilities data. Country reports are compiled into a .txt file and tabular data are provided in .csv format in this data release.
descript.purpose: This data release includes country-by-country mineral commodity production statistics for the years 2020 through 2024 as well as locations and production capacities of mineral facilities at yearend 2024. These data accompany the 2024 country reports in the U.S. Geological Survey's Minerals Yearbook Volume III: Area Reports — International (https://doi.org/10.3133/mybvIII); these reports analyze the importance of minerals to the economies of over 150 nations and the United States. Production and facility data are provided in a .csv format and country reports are provided in a .txt file.

procstep.procdesc: Information and data provided in this data release were researched, collected, analyzed, and prepared by National Minerals Information Center Country Specialists. Data are collected from a variety of sources, including USGS surveys sent to government and nongoverment entities throughout the world; government, industry, and company reports, news reports, and industry study groups. All country reports were compiled into a single .txt file. Tabular data were combined into a single Production table and a single Facilities table, both in .csv format. Sources used for this compilation of work are provided in the country reports, tables, and in the Data Quality Information section of this metadata. Past publications prepared by the U.S. Geological Survey's National Minerals Information Center may have also been referenced.
